title: Ultrascan
category: Social Media Design • Outdoor Advertising • Editorial Design • Stationery • Print Design
description: Ultrascan is a medical and diagnostic brand for which a wide range of visual communication materials was developed. The project focused on creating consistent and engaging designs for social media, outdoor advertising, certificates, educational books, vehicle branding, and stationery. The visual system uses a bold yellow, red, white, and dark navy palette to create a recognizable and energetic communication style across different applications.
challenge: One consistent look had to cover very different formats: social media, billboards, vehicle graphics, certificates, books and stationery, while presenting medical information in an accessible way.
solution: I built the Ultrascan system on yellow backgrounds, red accents, white typography and dark navy elements, with medical imagery and bold promotional layouts. It covers a large set of social media designs (educational, promotional, seasonal and informational), billboards, full vehicle branding, certificates, and books designed as covers and interior pages on subjects such as fetal echocardiography and gynecology. Branded stationery and other printed materials extend the same look.
results: One visual system across social media, billboards, vehicle branding, certificates, educational books and stationery, held together by a strong colour palette, clear information hierarchy, medical imagery and repeatable graphic elements.
